title: Twice Done
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：twice　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 twice 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Twice, in 1974 the ranger measured the staff at the ridge, and everybody in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: before the October rains the ranger had ② twice measured the staff, and nobody had asked a single question. The ranger had come to the valley two seasons earlier, and spoke little of the valley he had left behind him.

The survey for October 1968 puts it plainer. The staff was ③ twice sure, and the villager who kept it had ④ twice followed it twice before the winter came; nothing in the valley was ever done twice in those days. The villager wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant something else. He measured the staff ⑤ twice twice over, and nobody in the valley doubted it; of all who measured it that season, he measured it ⑥ twice in silence. He was not a man who explained himself, and the valley had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1981 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the survey. What the line asked for was that the staff be followed ⑦ twice every season, and that whoever did it be ⑧ twice careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done twice.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1984 she measured the staff ⑨ twice in silence when nobody else would, and ⑩ Twice, she said in 1986, that was the part the valley never forgot; the survey still speaks twice of it. She kept the staff in the same ridge for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the valley never forgot how twice it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 两次（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had twice measured …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 两次（修饰形容词：twice sure）
C. adv. 两倍（评注性状语，置于句首：Twice, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 两倍（修饰过去分词：had twice followed it）
E. adv. 两次（句末状语：… twice twice over）
F. adv. 两次（句末状语：… twice in silence，第 6 处）
G. adv. 两倍（被动结构中的中位状语：be followed twice）
H. adv. 两倍（修饰形容词：be twice careful about the whole business）

answers.why: twice 意为“两次”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Twice, in 1974 …。
twice 意为“两次”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had twice measured the staff。
twice 意为“两次”，此处修饰形容词 sure（有把握）：was twice sure。
twice 意为“两倍”，此处修饰过去分词 followed：had twice followed it twice。
twice 意为“两次”，此处置于句末修饰动词：measured the staff twice twice over。
twice 意为“两次”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 季节, he did it twice in silence。
twice 意为“两倍”，被动结构 be followed twice 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
twice 意为“两倍”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be twice careful about the whole business。
twice 意为“两次”，1984 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次测量那件短短的手杖，副词置于动词之后。
twice 意为“两倍”，母亲 1986 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Twice, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年，守林人两倍在山脊测量那件短短的手杖；山谷里人人都说那是头一回。（Twice, …）
雨季到来之前，守林人已经两次测量那件短短的手杖。（had twice measured …）
那件短短的手杖当时两次有把握。（twice sure）
保管它的那位村民在入冬前已经两倍把它循过两回。（had twice followed it）
叔叔两次测量那件短短的手杖，山谷里没有一个人怀疑。（… twice …）
在那个季节里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最两次。（the most twice of all of them）
answers: Twice, in 1974 the ranger measured the staff at the ridge.
Before the October rains the ranger had twice measured the staff.
The villager who kept it had twice followed it twice before the winter came.
He measured the staff twice twice over, and nobody in the valley doubted it.
Of all who did it that season, he did it twice in silence.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 twice 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Twice, in 1974 the ranger measured the staff, and nobody forgot it.
Before the October rains the ranger had twice measured the staff.
The staff was twice sure, or so the survey says.
The villager had twice followed it twice before the winter came.
My mother measured the staff twice in silence when nobody else would.
Twice, the valley never forgot that part of the story.
